name: FUTAMARKET
detailed_description:
The FutaGang have taken the control of the Underground and it's Black Market.

They are sexy, fearless and merciless!


You have been put in charge of a small store in the Underground by the gang and your job is to assist them by selling goods/services like extracting datas, unlocking phones, create fake credit cards, etc...

__________Story__________
- Manage your stock of goods/services: create your own stuff or make people do it for you.
- Meet the members of the FutaGang, bond with some members and discover who they truly are.
- Collect datas on the futanaris and improve your relationship score with them.
- Follow the story and discover what's really happenings in the Underground using your relations and the datas you collected.

__________What you can expect__________
- Story with dialogues & choices.
- Stock & Store management
- Multiple gameplays including managing the store/hacking/creating items
- Lot of futanaris: unlock bios, pictures & short movies.
